bullets.text: Residents in Thiruvallur district blocked a state transport bus with empty pots due to a week-long drinking water shortage.
Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the 14.6-km Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of Chennai Metro Phase II on the 11th.
Police arrested five people in Thiruvallur in connection with the murder of a shopkeeper over a daughter's relationship.
DMK MP Kanimozhi expressed shock over alleged restrictions on Instagram users criticizing the government and urged an inquiry.
CPM Tamil Nadu Secretary P. Shanmugam condemned the central and state governments for allowing a foreign university in the state.
At least 140 locations in Chennai will face a five-hour power supply disruption on October 7.
The Tamil Nadu Government Collegiate Teachers' Association strongly condemned establishing a foreign university at Velachery.
The proposed elevated bridge on Velachery Main Road has been cancelled in favor of widening the road.
Women in Ponneri besieged the block development office demanding safe drinking water and guaranteed 100 days of work.
Ponneri court cancelled the bail of notorious rowdy Dhanasekar who threatened a scrap shop owner for extortion money.
Residents submitted a petition to the Thiruvallur collector opposing a red soil quarry in the Ramathandalam lake.
The Tamil Nadu government shuffled three IAS officers, making changes in e-Governance and ELCOT administrative positions.
Nasscom is organizing nationwide workshops with MeitY on DPDPA readiness and operationalisation for the IT-ITeS industry.
A controversial viral video of a TVK candidate led to political clashes and accusations involving AI-generated media.
Minister Aadhav Arjuna dismissed the viral TVK candidate video controversy, stating it was an AI-generated clip.
Prime Minister Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to inaugurate the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro rail service.
Preparations are in full swing for Prime Minister Modi's visit to Chennai, including decoration works along metro pillars.
